propositions: The typecheck target in Makefile runs mypy only on src/rebar, leaving 47 Python files in scripts/ linted but type-unchecked despite scripts being CI-invoked gate implementations.

Type-checking scripts/ surfaces 15 mypy errors across 6 files, including latent bugs (capture_jira_fixtures calls .strip() on str | None; check_complexity_baseline passes possibly-None dict due to inadequate None guard placement).
The sys.path bootstraps in 9 scripts files do not block typecheck scope expansion because pyproject.toml's follow_imports=silent and ignore_missing_imports=true already handle path-injected imports.

Widening typecheck to include scripts/ requires fixing type errors at source, correcting stale scope descriptions in .pre-commit-config.yaml and .github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml, and adding a guard test to prevent regression.
